title: Publishing Workflow
description: Validates core/reference/publishing-workflow.yaml: the platform-neutral stages a release goes through to reach a portal, the state vocabulary a publication is reported in, and the publication key that identifies one artifact on one portal game across runs. Per-portal status is not here: it has one home, the readiness matrix in docs/portal-publishing-architecture.md. Referential rules the schema cannot state (every step, gate, lifecycle state, outcome, waiting state, refusal code and registry status exists) are wgflib.publication.publishing_workflow_problems, run by scripts/check-integrity.py.

portal.description: What drives a portal console: the profile's intents run by Playwright in a headed browser window the publish step opens, where a person logs in live.

ci_publishes.description: CI/CD never publishes a game: no pipeline uploads, submits or holds a portal session.

outcome.description: The platform-publication outcomes reported as this state.

refusal.description: The publish step's refusal codes reported as this state.

waiting.description: The platform-publication waiting state reported as this state.

registry.description: The portal registry status reported as this state.

step.description: The new-game workflow step that carries it out; null: a person, or a command outside the run.
